newsitem.title: GERMANY: Reuters, Havas launch new ad service.
newsitem.headline: Reuters, Havas launch new ad service.

text.p: International news and information organisation Reuters Holdings Plc and French media company Havas on Wednesday launched a data service for the advertising and media industry.
The new joint venture, Adways Data, offers companies access to information to help plan advertising campaigns in the media, Adways said in a statement at a Munich Advertising Conference.
The service includes programming overviews of stations, prices of advertising time, media ratings and industry news.
"With Adways Data, media industry representatives can react immediately to programming changes or special offers for advertising slots in the media," Adways said.

The company also develops and distributes online information services for the European advertising and media market, called the Reuters Advertising & Media Briefing, available in French, German and English.
Adways Data said it will also soon begin offering customers online booking of advertising time.
